page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Above the text: a decorative woodcut border (fleuron band), then a title block in italic and roman type. Below the text: a page signature/number line "* 2" at left and a catchword "p-" at right.

main_text.l: Oxon a R. S. sacræ Theologiæ Regio
est hoc professorii sive muneris de-
legatum, sive oneris impositum esse sensi:
audentioremque; quam ego me aut esse puto,
aut haberi velim, a suscipiendo tam ar-
cum omni tempore difficilisstum illis, nisi pa-

page.notes: The first letter P is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the word "Postquam". Line "horrucrim totus" is as printed (probably "horrucrim" for horrorem); marked for doubt. Catchword "pa-" partly damaged at right edge; the final line reads "p-" in the scan and may be incomplete. Stains and binding shadow at left edge omitted.
